tools.name: agent_execute
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Run a task on a previously-spawned agent_spawn record via the Anthropic Messages API with that agent's configured model. Use when native Task tool is wrong because (a) you need the spawned agent's persistent config (model, instructions, cost-tracking attribution) to apply to this turn, (b) the result needs to feed back into the agent's lifecycle (taskCount, lastResult, swarm-coordinated state), or (c) you want explicit model routing via the spawn record's `model` field instead of inheriting. For one-shot Claude prompts without a tracked agent, native Task is fine. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in env.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"agentId":{"description":"ID of the spawned agent","type":"string"},"maxTokens":{"description":"Max output tokens (default 1024)","type":"number"},"prompt":{"description":"Task / prompt for the agent to execute","type":"string"},"systemPrompt":{"description":"Optional system prompt (overrides agent default)","type":"string"},"temperature":{"description":"Sampling temperature 0..1 (default 0.7)","type":"number"}},"required":["agentId","prompt"],"type":"object"},"name":"agent_execute"}

tools.name: agent_health
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Report measured agent_execute provider-call outcomes over the last 20 calls: API success-ratio health (0-1), error rate, and response-latency p50/p95. This does not measure task correctness. Agents with no observed calls have unknown health; registration is not proof of a running process. Native Task and hooks_post-task outcomes are not recorded here. Use when you need measured reliability for agents driven through agent_execute; native Task results are invisible to this tool, so inspect those directly.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"agentId":{"description":"Specific agent ID (optional)","type":"string"},"threshold":{"description":"Health threshold (0-1)","type":"number"}},"type":"object"},"name":"agent_health"}

tools.name: agent_list
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"List every Ruflo-tracked agent in the registry with its type, model, status, and taskCount. Use when native Task tool is wrong because you need to see the swarm-wide agent inventory across turns (which agents exist, their roles, their cost-tracking handles) rather than spawn a new one-shot Task. Filter by status/domain/agentType if needed. For starting a fresh single-shot subagent, native Task is fine.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"agentType":{"description":"Filter by agent type","type":"string"},"domain":{"description":"Filter by domain","type":"string"},"includeTerminated":{"description":"Include terminated agents","type":"boolean"},"status":{"description":"Filter by status","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"agent_list"}

tools.name: agent_logs
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Return recorded activity-log entries for a tracked agent (idle/running history, last task result). Use when native Task tool is wrong because you need the agent's log across turns (what it did, last error/result, swarm context) rather than a one-shot Task transcript. For a Task you just ran, native Task output is fine. Pair with agent_list to find the agentId. (Hive-mind-spawned workers are resolved here too.) Today this returns the last task result as a synthetic entry — full per-agent activity logs land with hive worker execution wiring (ruvnet/ruflo#1916).","inputSchema":{"properties":{"agentId":{"description":"ID of agent","type":"string"},"level":{"description":"Minimum log level (currently advisory — entries are synthetic)","enum":["debug","info","warn","error"],"type":"string"},"since":{"description":"Show logs since, e.g. \"1h\" / \"30m\" (currently advisory)","type":"string"},"tail":{"description":"Max recent entries to return (default 50)","type":"number"}},"required":["agentId"],"type":"object"},"name":"agent_logs"}

tools.name: agent_pool
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Manage a fixed-size warm pool of pre-spawned agents to skip cold-start cost on bursty workloads. Use when native Task is wrong because (a) you have a queue of similar tasks and want to amortize spawn latency, (b) cost-tracking wants stable agentIds across requests, or (c) swarm topology requires a known agent count at all times. For one-shot work, just call agent_spawn or native Task. Pool sizes and warm/idle thresholds are set per-pool.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"action":{"description":"Pool action","enum":["status","scale","drain","fill"],"type":"string"},"agentType":{"description":"Agent type filter","type":"string"},"targetSize":{"description":"Target pool size (scale: grow or shrink to it; fill: grow to it, never shrink)","type":"number"}},"required":["action"],"type":"object"},"name":"agent_pool"}

tools.name: agent_spawn
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Spawn a Ruflo-tracked agent with cost attribution + memory persistence + swarm coordination. Use when native Task tool is wrong because you need (a) cost tracking per agent in the cost-tracking namespace, (b) cross-session learning via the patterns namespace, or (c) coordination with other agents in a swarm topology (hierarchical / mesh / consensus). For one-shot subtasks with no learning loop, native Task is fine. Pair with hooks_route to pick the right model first.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"agentId":{"description":"Optional custom agent ID","type":"string"},"agentType":{"description":"Type of agent to spawn (a legacy `type` key is accepted as an alias)","type":"string"},"config":{"description":"Agent configuration","type":"object"},"domain":{"description":"Agent domain","type":"string"},"memoryBase":{"description":"Opt-in: base .rvf memory file to fork a per-agent Copy-On-Write branch from (agenticow). When set, the agent gets an isolated ~162-byte COW branch instead of a full copy — promote on success, discard on terminate. Requires the optional `agenticow` dep; degrades to a no-op when absent or when CLAUDE_FLOW_NO_COW_MEMORY=1.","type":"string"},"memoryDimension":{"description":"Vector dimension for the COW base (required only when memoryBase does not exist yet)","type":"integer"},"model":{"description":"Claude model alias (haiku=fast/cheap, sonnet=balanced, opus=current Opus 4.8, opus-4.7=prior Opus pin)","enum":["haiku","sonnet","opus","opus-4.7","inherit"],"type":"string"},"name":{"description":"Optional display name for the agent (shown by agent_list, agent_status and ruflo-console)","type":"string"},"swarmId":{"description":"Optional swarm to register the agent with (defaults to most-recent swarm)","type":"string"},"task":{"description":"Task description for intelligent model routing","type":"string"}},"required":["agentType"],"type":"object"},"name":"agent_spawn"}

Pair with agent_list to find the agentId first.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"agentId":{"description":"ID of agent","type":"string"}},"required":["agentId"],"type":"object"},"name":"agent_status"}

tools.name: agent_terminate
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Remove a Ruflo-tracked agent from the registry and free its swarm slot. tools.name: agent_update

tools.name: agentdb_graph-pathfinder
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Multi-algorithm native graph pathfinder (ADR-130 Phase 5). Use when agentdb_graph-query k-hop is not enough — pathfinder supports personalized-pagerank, dynamic-mincut, spectral-sparsify, temporal-centrality, connected-component-churn, and witness-chain-divergence. Prefer over prompt-level graph loops in ruflo-knowledge-graph graph-navigator when you need ranked paths with formal complexityBudget enforcement.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"algorithm":{"description":"Graph algorithm (default: personalized-pagerank)","enum":["personalized-pagerank","dynamic-mincut","spectral-sparsify","temporal-centrality","connected-component-churn","witness-chain-divergence"],"type":"string"},"complexityBudget":{"properties":{"maxDepth":{"type":"number"},"maxMemoryMB":{"type":"number"},"maxMillis":{"type":"number"},"maxNodesVisited":{"type":"number"}},"type":"object"},"depth":{"description":"Expansion depth (default 3, max 5)","type":"number"},"query":{"description":"Natural-language query for relevance scoring","type":"string"},"seedNodeId":{"description":"Domain-prefixed start node (e.g. \"entity:auth-module\")","type":"string"},"threshold":{"description":"Minimum cumulative relevance score (default 0.3)","type":"number"},"topK":{"description":"Max paths returned (default 10)","type":"number"}},"required":["seedNodeId","query"],"type":"object"},"name":"agentdb_graph-pathfinder"}

tools.name: agentdb_graph-query

Use when you need relationship traversal beyond flat memory search.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"complexityBudget":{"description":"Computation limits","properties":{"maxDepth":{"type":"number"},"maxMemoryMB":{"type":"number"},"maxMillis":{"type":"number"},"maxNodesVisited":{"type":"number"}},"type":"object"},"depth":{"description":"Requested k-hop depth (default 2, max 5); SQL responses report appliedDepth and truncated when limited to 3","type":"number"},"mode":{"description":"Query mode: k-hop neighbor expansion, semantic cosine search, or PageRank scoring","enum":["k-hop","semantic","pagerank"],"type":"string"},"nodeId":{"description":"Domain-prefixed node ID (e.g. \"agent:abc\", \"entity:xyz\")","type":"string"},"relation":{"description":"Optional edge relation filter","type":"string"},"topK":{"description":"Max results for semantic and pagerank modes (default 10)","type":"number"}},"required":["nodeId","mode"],"type":"object"},"name":"agentdb_graph-query"}

tools.name: agenticow_branch
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agenticow@~0.2.3 — COW-fork a base .rvf memory file. Measured 162-byte branches regardless of base size (verified at N=1k/10k/50k). Use when you need per-Darwin-iteration / per-user / per-session memory personalization. Copying the parent .rvf file is wrong because full-copy snapshots grow linearly (the 3.3 GB Darwin-worktree bloat fixed in v3.14.4); agenticow gives read-through semantics (parent ∪ edits, child wins) at constant 162 B. Optional dep — degrades to {degraded:true} when missing.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"basePath":{"description":"Path to base .rvf memory file (absolute or relative to cwd)","type":"string"},"branchPath":{"description":"Path to write the branch file","type":"string"},"dimension":{"description":"Vector dimension (required only when basePath does not exist yet)","type":"integer"},"label":{"description":"Human-readable label for the branch (alnum + _.-:/@ only)","type":"string"},"nativeAnn":{"default":false,"description":"Use the native Rust COW dual-graph ANN path (recall@10=1.0, query spans the COW boundary in one Rust call). Default false (exact JS chain-walk). Set true when the branch will be queried.","type":"boolean"}},"required":["basePath","branchPath","label"],"type":"object"},"name":"agenticow_branch"}

tools.name: agenticow_checkpoint
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agenticow — freeze a labelled restore point on an .rvf memory file. Subsequent edits stay in a fresh COW child; rollback returns here. Use when you are about to run an experimental Darwin tick or speculative agent edit that may need to be discarded. Relying on the working node alone is wrong because there is no \"undo last N writes\" semantics — without a checkpoint, a bad ingest contaminates the base. Persists via .agenticow.json lineage manifest so it survives close+reopen.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"label":{"description":"Checkpoint label (alnum + _.-:/@ only)","type":"string"},"path":{"description":"Path to .rvf memory file","type":"string"}},"required":["path","label"],"type":"object"},"name":"agenticow_checkpoint"}

tools.name: agenticow_diff
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agenticow — show what a branch changed relative to its lineage: {added, overridden, deleted} vector-id lists. Use when you are about to promote and want to preview the exact merge, or when auditing what a branch actually wrote. Diffing by re-querying is wrong because deletions (tombstones) are invisible to a read — diff() surfaces them explicitly. Requires the branch was opened with edit tracking (default on).","inputSchema":{"properties":{"path":{"description":"Path to branch .rvf file","type":"string"}},"required":["path"],"type":"object"},"name":"agenticow_diff"}

tools.name: agenticow_ingest
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agenticow — write vectors (with optional text payloads) into an .rvf memory branch or base. Records: [{id?, vector, text?}] — id auto-assigns when omitted. This is the write half that makes a branch usable: agenticow_branch creates an empty COW child, but without ingest it has nothing to read back. Use when you have branched and must populate the branch (agenticow_branch alone leaves it empty). Editing the base directly is wrong when the writes are speculative — ingest into a branch, then promote only if validated. Persists via .agenticow.json lineage manifest.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"dimension":{"description":"Vector dimension (required only when path does not exist yet)","type":"integer"},"path":{"description":"Path to .rvf memory file (branch or base)","type":"string"},"records":{"description":"Vectors to ingest: [{id?: number, vector: number[], text?: string}]","items":{"properties":{"id":{"description":"Explicit id (auto-assigned when omitted)","type":"integer"},"text":{"description":"Optional payload surfaced on query hits","type":"string"},"vector":{"description":"Embedding vector (length must equal the memory dimension)","items":{"type":"number"},"type":"array"}},"required":["vector"],"type":"object"},"type":"array"}},"required":["path","records"],"type":"object"},"name":"agenticow_ingest"}

tools.name: agenticow_lineage
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agenticow — walk the COW chain of an .rvf memory file: an ordered list of nodes (role working|checkpoint|base, id, label, parent, createdAt, mutations, tombstones). Use when you need branch history — to find checkpoint ids for a targeted rollback, or to debug a promote. Guessing the chain from filenames is wrong — lineage is the authoritative structure the store maintains.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"path":{"description":"Path to .rvf memory file","type":"string"}},"required":["path"],"type":"object"},"name":"agenticow_lineage"}

tools.name: agenticow_promote
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agenticow — merge a branch's edits back into its base (or an explicit target) memory file. After promote, branch edits become part of base lineage. Use when a per-user / per-Darwin-iteration branch has been validated and should graduate to shared memory (federation merge, A/B winner). Manually re-ingesting edits into the base is wrong because the edit set is opaque to the caller and tombstones (deletions) are easily missed; promote applies the full edit + tombstone set atomically.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"basePath":{"description":"Path to base .rvf file. When omitted, promote merges into the recorded fork parent (most common case).","type":"string"},"branchPath":{"description":"Path to branch .rvf file","type":"string"}},"required":["branchPath"],"type":"object"},"name":"agenticow_promote"}

tools.name: agenticow_query
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agenticow — k-NN read across an .rvf memory branch's full COW lineage (parent ∪ edits, child wins), returning {id, distance, branch, text}. Read-only (no manifest write). The `branch` field on each hit tells you which lineage node the result came from — the read-through semantics that make branching useful. Use when you need to read from an agent/session branch without materializing a full copy. tools.name: federation_bbs_human_join
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agentbbs — Mint a single-use Ed25519-signed token a human business owner presents to the agentbbs SSH/web front door to join a room (ADR-164 §3.2.4). Returns webUrl + sshCommand + handshakeToken + expiresAt. Use when the cockpit operator needs scoped, time-limited access to a room without sharing the federation root keypair. Issuing a permanent bearer token is wrong because the agentbbs server enforces single-use JTI replay protection and the 15-min default TTL — a long-lived token defeats both. Optional dep — degrades to {degraded:true} when missing.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"roomId":{"description":"Room the token authorizes.","type":"string"},"ttlSeconds":{"description":"Token lifetime in seconds. Max 900 (15 min). Default 300.","type":"integer"}},"required":["roomId"],"type":"object"},"name":"federation_bbs_human_join"}

tools.name: federation_bbs_identity
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agentbbs Phase 2 — return this host's persistent federation node identity (nodeId + Ed25519 public key), creating it on first call. Give the nodeId and publicKey to a peer so they can pin you with federation_bbs_peer_add. The private key never leaves this host and is never returned. Use when you are bootstrapping a new host into the federation and a peer needs something to pin. Reading node-identity.json directly is wrong because it also holds the private key, and the file is created lazily so it may not exist yet.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"basePath":{"description":"Override the .agentbbs directory.","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"federation_bbs_identity"}

tools.name: federation_bbs_peer_add
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agentbbs Phase 2 — pin a remote federation peer by nodeId, URL and Ed25519 public key. The key is pinned at add time and every envelope merged from this peer is verified against it, so a hostile peer cannot forge another node's envelopes. Re-adding a known nodeId with a different key is refused; remove it first. Max 256 peers. Use when you have a peer's identity out of band and want to start syncing with it. Trusting a key carried inside an incoming envelope is wrong because that only proves the sender holds some key, not that they are the node they claim to be.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"basePath":{"type":"string"},"label":{"description":"Optional human label.","type":"string"},"nodeId":{"description":"Peer's 16-hex nodeId from its federation_bbs_identity.","type":"string"},"publicKey":{"description":"Peer's 64-hex Ed25519 public key.","type":"string"},"url":{"description":"Peer base URL, e.g. http://100.104.125.72:7777","type":"string"}},"required":["nodeId","url","publicKey"],"type":"object"},"name":"federation_bbs_peer_add"}

tools.name: federation_bbs_peers
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agentbbs Phase 2 — list pinned federation peers with last-sync state. Public keys are returned so an operator can compare a pin against what the peer reports; private material is never included. Use when you want to audit who this host will accept envelopes from, or unpin a peer. Editing peers.json by hand is wrong because a malformed entry silently disables verification for that peer on the next sync.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"basePath":{"type":"string"},"remove":{"description":"Optional nodeId to unpin instead of listing.","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"federation_bbs_peers"}

tools.name: federation_bbs_publish
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agentbbs — Publish a domain event from a pod agent to a BBS room (ADR-164 Phase 1). Wraps the payload in a ReplicateMessage envelope (envelopeId, seq, ts, msgType, payload) and appends it to the room log. Use when an agent has produced a typed event (pod-status, task-result, alert, human-override-ack, bench-result) that the human cockpit or other pods need to see. Storing into raw memory_store is wrong because it skips the room-scoped budget cap, PII pipeline gating, and monotonic seq numbering that ADR-164 §3.2.2 requires. Optional dep — degrades to {degraded:true} when missing.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"basePath":{"description":"Directory where BBS room state is persisted (defaults to <cwd>/.agentbbs).","type":"string"},"msgType":{"description":"Typed event kind (pod-status / task-result / alert / human-override-ack / bench-result).","type":"string"},"payload":{"description":"Event-specific JSON-serializable payload.","type":"object"},"roomId":{"description":"Target room identifier as returned by federation_bbs_register.","type":"string"},"signature":{"description":"Optional Ed25519 signature over the canonical envelope bytes. Phase 1: pass-through.","type":"string"}},"required":["roomId","msgType","payload"],"type":"object"},"name":"federation_bbs_publish"}

tools.name: federation_bbs_register
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agentbbs@~0.1.0 — Register a BBS room as a named federation peer (ADR-164 Phase 1). Maps a business-domain label like \"#sales\" or \"#finance\" to a stable roomId and emits an attested PeerHello envelope. Use when you are scaffolding the business-autopilot cockpit and need a room handle that subsequent publish/watch calls can target. Calling FederationCoordinator.joinPeer() directly is wrong because it bypasses the room policy bag (PII mode, budget cap, preferLocal routing) that the BBS plugin layers on top. Optional dep — degrades to {degraded:true} when missing.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"agentbbsBin":{"description":"Optional explicit path to the agentbbs binary. Reserved for Phase 2 wire-up; ignored in Phase 1.","type":"string"},"basePath":{"description":"Directory where BBS room state is persisted (defaults to <cwd>/.agentbbs).","type":"string"},"roomLabel":{"description":"Human-readable room label, e.g. \"#sales\" or \"finance\". May include alnum + _.-:/@# .","type":"string"}},"required":["roomLabel"],"type":"object"},"name":"federation_bbs_register"}

tools.name: federation_bbs_serve
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agentbbs Phase 2 — start the read-only pull endpoint peers fetch from (GET /agentbbs/v1/rooms/:roomId/envelopes). Binds 127.0.0.1 unless bindHost is given explicitly, so room contents are never exposed on a routable interface by accident. There is no route that mutates state. Use when this host needs to be reachable by peers that pull from it. Exposing the .agentbbs directory over a static file server is wrong because that would serve node-identity.json, which contains the private key.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"basePath":{"type":"string"},"bindHost":{"description":"Interface to bind. Defaults to 127.0.0.1; set a tailnet IP to federate.","type":"string"},"port":{"description":"Port to listen on. 0 picks a free one.","type":"number"}},"type":"object"},"name":"federation_bbs_serve"}

tools.name: federation_bbs_sync
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agentbbs Phase 2 — pull a room from pinned peers and union-merge what verifies. Merge is keyed on envelopeId so it is idempotent and order-independent; unsigned, misattributed, oversize and over-hop (>8) envelopes are dropped and counted rather than merged. Use after publish to propagate, or on a timer to converge. Use when you want to converge this host's rooms with its peers, on demand or on a timer. Copying room-*.jsonl between machines is wrong because it bypasses signature verification, dedupe and the hop limit, so a single hostile or looping file can corrupt the log.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"basePath":{"type":"string"},"nodeId":{"description":"Optional single peer to sync from; default is all pinned peers.","type":"string"},"roomId":{"description":"Room to sync. Same label yields the same roomId on every host.","type":"string"}},"required":["roomId"],"type":"object"},"name":"federation_bbs_sync"}

tools.name: federation_bbs_watch
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"agentbbs — Poll recent envelopes from a BBS room (ADR-164 Phase 1). Returns envelopes newer than the optional sinceEnvelopeId, up to limit. Use when a pod agent needs to see incoming human overrides, new tasks, or peer events posted to its room. Polling memory_search for the room namespace is wrong because it loses the monotonic seq ordering and re-runs PII gating per query; this tool reads the canonical envelope log directly. Phase 1 is polling — Phase 4 layers streaming on the same surface. Optional dep — degrades to {degraded:true} when missing.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"basePath":{"description":"Directory where BBS room state is persisted (defaults to <cwd>/.agentbbs).","type":"string"},"limit":{"description":"Maximum envelopes to return (default 50, max 500).","type":"integer"},"roomId":{"description":"Room identifier to watch.","type":"string"},"sinceEnvelopeId":{"description":"Only return envelopes strictly after this id. Omit to return the most recent window.","type":"string"}},"required":["roomId"],"type":"object"},"name":"federation_bbs_watch"}

tools.name: hooks_codemod

Uses the TypeScript compiler with formatting-preserving edits (comments/whitespace survive). Targets: raw `code` (returns transformed text, writes nothing) | a single `file` | a `files` array | a `glob` pattern (batch — applies the intent across every match in one $0 call). Files are rewritten in place unless `dryRun`. Intents that need reasoning — add-types, add-error-handling, async-await — are NOT supported here; route those to a model via hooks_model-route. tools.name: hooks_intelligence_unified-stats

tools.name: hooks_model-verify
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Verify a generated output with CHEAP structural signals ($0, no LLM call) and get an escalation verdict — the post-generation half of confidence-gated tier routing (route → generate → verify → escalate on failure). Checks: empty/truncated output, refusal patterns, degenerate repetition, and real syntax parsing for code/JSON tasks (TypeScript compiler / JSON.parse). Returns {confident, reasons[], suggestedTier, suggestedModel, escalate}. By default the verdict is recorded into the model-routing learning stream (success when confident, escalated when not) so the bandit learns which task shapes the cheap tier fails on. Use when you just generated with the tier hooks_model-route picked and must decide accept-vs-escalate BEFORE acting on the output; accepting cheap-tier output unverified is wrong because structurally unusable results (refusals, truncation, unparseable code) silently propagate downstream, and pre-generation routing alone cannot catch them. Not a semantic-quality judge — it only catches structurally unusable outputs.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"model":{"description":"Model that produced the output (drives the escalation ladder; default haiku)","enum":["haiku","sonnet","opus"],"type":"string"},"output":{"description":"The generated output to verify","type":"string"},"record":{"description":"Record the verdict into the routing learning stream (default true; requires model)","type":"boolean"},"task":{"description":"The task the output was generated for","type":"string"},"taskKind":{"description":"Force the task kind; default auto-detect","enum":["code","json","text","auto"],"type":"string"},"tierUsed":{"description":"Tier that produced the output; derived from model when absent","enum":[1,2,3],"type":"number"}},"required":["task","output"],"type":"object"},"name":"hooks_model-verify"}

tools.name: http_fetch
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"ADR-164 §5.1.8 — HTTP probe primitive for business-pod ops benches (synthetic 200/500 endpoint checks, third-party status pages). Default-secure: blocks file://, ftp://, and RFC-1918 / loopback / link-local hosts, whether given as an address or as a name that resolves to one (checked on the connection itself, every redirect hop included), unless CLAUDE_FLOW_HTTP_FETCH_ALLOW_PRIVATE=1, and rejects Authorization / Cookie / X-Auth-* headers unless CLAUDE_FLOW_HTTP_FETCH_ALLOW_AUTH=1. Hard 30s timeout (60s ceiling), response truncated to 256 KB (1 MB ceiling), default User-Agent ruflo-http-fetch/1.0. Use when a pod or smoke contract needs a guarded HTTP probe — calling Node fetch() directly is wrong because it skips the URL allowlist and header sanitization that ADR-164 mandates for autopilot mode. Pair with the ops-pod bench in plugins/ruflo-business-pods/templates/ops.json (the §4.4 synthetic-endpoint test).","inputSchema":{"properties":{"body":{"description":"Request body for POST. Ignored for GET / HEAD.","type":"string"},"headers":{"description":"Extra request headers. Authorization / Cookie / X-Auth-* blocked unless CLAUDE_FLOW_HTTP_FETCH_ALLOW_AUTH=1.","type":"object"},"maxResponseBytes":{"description":"Max body bytes to read before truncation. Default 262144 (256 KB), max 1048576 (1 MB).","type":"number"},"method":{"description":"HTTP method. Defaults to GET.","enum":["GET","POST","HEAD"],"type":"string"},"timeoutMs":{"description":"Hard timeout in milliseconds. Default 30000, max 60000.","type":"number"},"url":{"description":"Absolute http:// or https:// URL. file://, ftp://, RFC-1918 / loopback / link-local blocked by default.","type":"string"}},"required":["url"],"type":"object"},"name":"http_fetch"}

tools.name: metaharness_learn

Use when you need the GPU side of a CUDA program (which architectures it targets, whether it ships PTX, which kernels exist and what each costs): rure_analyze_binary alone only shows the .nv_fatbin section names, and grep or strings find kernel names only by chance. tools.name: team_send

tools.name: team_shutdown

For just reading the file, native Read is fine. (Basic checks today — a full workflow-schema validator is a tracked follow-up.)","inputSchema":{"properties":{"file":{"description":"Path to the workflow definition file","type":"string"},"strict":{"description":"Treat warnings as errors","type":"boolean"}},"required":["file"],"type":"object"},"name":"workflow_validate"}

tools.name: x_federation_admit
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Admit a Nostr pubkey as a relay member directly (NIP-43 kind 9030). Requires RUFLO_X_ADMIN_TOKEN. Use when a known node reports its 64-hex pubkey and you want to skip the invite step. Padding or hand-editing a reported pubkey is wrong because it is a cryptographic identity; a malformed key must be re-reported, never fixed up.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"gatewayUrl":{"description":"Compatibility assertion: must match RUFLO_X_GATEWAY_URL (default https://x.ruv.io). Change the server environment to select another gateway.","type":"string"},"pubkey":{"description":"64-hex secp256k1 x-only pubkey.","type":"string"},"role":{"enum":["member","admin"],"type":"string"}},"required":["pubkey"],"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_admit"}

tools.name: x_federation_channel_accept
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Accept private-channel grants addressed to your key: finds ChannelGrant events tagged to your pubkey, opens each with your own secret key, and caches the channel keys locally. Use when someone tells you they granted you a channel. Asking them to send you the key directly is wrong because it exposes a bearer secret in a channel you do not control.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"relayWs":{"description":"Relay URL; takes precedence over RUFLO_X_RELAY_WS.","type":"string"},"sinceSeconds":{"description":"Look-back window (default 7 days).","type":"number"}},"required":[],"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_channel_accept"}

tools.name: x_federation_channel_create
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Create a swarm channel. visibility=public gives a named stream every relay member can read (pub:<name>). visibility=private generates a 32-byte key HERE, stores it at ~/.ruflo/channels.json (0600), and returns an opaque id (prv:<hex>) that leaks neither the name nor the topic. Use when a stream of work should be separated from the shared firehose, or kept unreadable by the relay and the gateway. Creating a private channel and then expecting the gateway to read it is wrong: the gateway holds no channel key and cannot decrypt (ADR-386). Losing the key file loses the channel.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"name":{"description":"Channel name, [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}. For a private channel this is a local label only — it never reaches the relay.","type":"string"},"visibility":{"description":"public = plaintext, readable by all members. private = NIP-44 encrypted under a key only you hold.","enum":["public","private"],"type":"string"}},"required":["name","visibility"],"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_channel_create"}

tools.name: x_federation_channel_grant
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Grant a member access to a private channel by sealing its key to their pubkey with NIP-44 (ECDH), published as a ChannelGrant event only they can open. Use when adding a participant to an existing private channel. Publishing the raw key into a channel or a chat is wrong: it is a bearer secret, and anyone who sees it can read every past and future message, because there is no revocation.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"channel":{"description":"Private channel id (prv:<16 hex>) you hold the key for.","type":"string"},"pubkey":{"description":"The member's 64-hex Nostr pubkey.","type":"string"},"relayWs":{"description":"Relay URL; takes precedence over RUFLO_X_RELAY_WS (default wss://relay.ruv.io).","type":"string"}},"required":["channel","pubkey"],"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_channel_grant"}

tools.name: x_federation_channel_list
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"List the private channels this machine holds keys for, plus their local labels. Use when you want to know what you can actually read before calling channel_read. The gateway channel_list is the wrong tool for that: it reports channels seen on the relay, including ones whose contents you cannot open.","inputSchema":{"properties":{},"required":[],"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_channel_list"}

tools.name: x_federation_channel_publish
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Publish a message to a channel with YOUR OWN key. A private channel is encrypted locally under its channel key before it leaves this machine, and the message type is hidden behind k=enc so the relay sees only an opaque id and ciphertext. Use when the message should be attributable to you. The admin-gated gateway channel_publish is wrong for that, because it signs as the gateway and cannot reach private channels at all.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"channel":{"description":"Channel id (pub:<name> or prv:<16 hex>).","type":"string"},"msgType":{"description":"Message type (Status, Task, Result, …). Hidden on private channels.","type":"string"},"payload":{"description":"JSON body. Never put secrets or credentials in it, even on a private channel.","type":"object"},"relayWs":{"description":"Relay URL; takes precedence over RUFLO_X_RELAY_WS.","type":"string"}},"required":["channel","msgType","payload"],"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_channel_publish"}

tools.name: x_federation_channel_read
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Read a channel and decrypt what your keys can open. Public messages come back as JSON; private ones are decrypted locally with the cached channel key, and anything you have no key for is returned as encrypted:true rather than silently dropped. Use when the channel is private: reading it through the gateway channel_sync tool is wrong there, because the gateway holds no key and can only hand you ciphertext.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"channel":{"description":"Channel id (pub:<name> or prv:<16 hex>).","type":"string"},"limit":{"description":"Max messages (default 100).","type":"number"},"relayWs":{"description":"Relay URL; takes precedence over RUFLO_X_RELAY_WS.","type":"string"},"sinceSeconds":{"description":"Look-back window (default 3600).","type":"number"}},"required":["channel"],"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_channel_read"}

tools.name: x_federation_claims
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Return the current owner-per-resource work-claims ledger for the open swarm (ruv://claims/board). Use when you are about to start shared work and need to know whether a resourceId is already owned. Inferring ownership from raw ClaimIssued events is wrong because releases, TTL expiry and handoffs change the answer; the board applies those rules.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"gatewayUrl":{"description":"Compatibility assertion: must match RUFLO_X_GATEWAY_URL (default https://x.ruv.io). Change the server environment to select another gateway.","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_claims"}

tools.name: x_federation_invite_mint
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Mint a use-limited, expiring invite code so a new ruflo user can self-join the open federation with THEIR OWN key. Requires RUFLO_X_ADMIN_TOKEN. Use when onboarding someone. Sharing the relay owner key instead is wrong because invites are revocable, hashed at rest, and bind membership to the claimant's key; the code is a bearer secret — hand it over privately.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"gatewayUrl":{"description":"Compatibility assertion: must match RUFLO_X_GATEWAY_URL (default https://x.ruv.io). Change the server environment to select another gateway.","type":"string"},"maxUses":{"description":"Redemptions (default 25).","type":"number"},"ttlSecs":{"description":"Validity (default 7 days).","type":"number"}},"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_invite_mint"}

tools.name: x_federation_join
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Join the federation with YOUR OWN local key, without an invite when public registration is enabled. Reuses ~/.ruflo/nostr.key (0600), proves key ownership with NIP-98, and verifies membership with NIP-42. Use when a user wants to join as themselves. Publishing as the gateway is wrong for personal identity. Optional private invite codes remain supported; never share keys or codes in chat.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"code":{"description":"Optional private invite code (v2.…), for invite-only relays.","type":"string"},"gatewayUrl":{"description":"Public registration gateway origin; defaults to https://x.ruv.io.","type":"string"},"keyFile":{"description":"Key file path; takes precedence over RUFLO_NOSTR_KEY_FILE (default ~/.ruflo/nostr.key).","type":"string"},"relayHttp":{"description":"Relay HTTPS base for the claim; takes precedence over RUFLO_X_RELAY_HTTP.","type":"string"},"relayWs":{"description":"Relay wss URL for NIP-42; takes precedence over RUFLO_X_RELAY_WS.","type":"string"}},"required":[],"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_join"}

tools.name: x_federation_publish
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Publish a signed coordination message to the open swarm AS THE GATEWAY identity (Status/Task/Result/…). Requires RUFLO_X_ADMIN_TOKEN. Use when a trusted operator needs a hub-level broadcast. Using this to post on behalf of an individual node is wrong because it attributes the message to the gateway, not the node — nodes should join with their own key via invite→claim and publish themselves.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"gatewayUrl":{"description":"Compatibility assertion: must match RUFLO_X_GATEWAY_URL (default https://x.ruv.io). Change the server environment to select another gateway.","type":"string"},"msgType":{"type":"string"},"payload":{"type":"object"}},"required":["msgType","payload"],"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_publish"}

tools.name: x_federation_registry
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Read the federation registry resource (ruv://federation/registry): relay URL, canonical relay tag for NIP-42, gateway pubkey, and the exact self-join steps. Use when onboarding a new node or user to the open federation. Hard-coding the relay URL is wrong because the relay verifies the NIP-42 relay tag strictly against its canonical host, which this resource states.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"gatewayUrl":{"description":"Compatibility assertion: must match RUFLO_X_GATEWAY_URL (default https://x.ruv.io). Change the server environment to select another gateway.","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_registry"}

tools.name: x_federation_roster
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"List nodes currently announcing themselves on the open swarm (recent PeerHello events) via the ruv://swarm/roster resource. Use when you need to know who is online across the federation before assigning work. Grepping sync output by hand is wrong because the roster resource already de-duplicates by pubkey and carries lastSeen.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"gatewayUrl":{"description":"Compatibility assertion: must match RUFLO_X_GATEWAY_URL (default https://x.ruv.io). Change the server environment to select another gateway.","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_roster"}

tools.name: x_federation_sync
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Fetch recent signature-verified coordination messages from the open x.ruv.io swarm federation (Nostr, #t=ruflo-swarm). Use when you need to see what other ruflo nodes across the internet have posted (PeerHello/Status/Task/Result/Claim*). Reading the relay directly is wrong because you would have to do NIP-42 auth yourself; the gateway does it and only returns events whose signatures verify.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"gatewayUrl":{"description":"Compatibility assertion: must match RUFLO_X_GATEWAY_URL (default https://x.ruv.io). Change the server environment to select another gateway.","type":"string"},"limit":{"description":"Max messages (default 100).","type":"number"},"sinceSeconds":{"description":"Look-back window (default 3600).","type":"number"},"type":{"description":"Optional message type filter, e.g. Task.","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"x_federation_sync"}

tools.name: leadsradar_account_deep_research
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"账号深度研究（与插件账号页「账号深度研究」按钮同源同引擎，账号级深度研究有且只有这一种）：本地素材足够（≥10 条作品且 8 条有正文）直接 AI 分析（约 2-6 分钟）；不足自动先深采 20 条作品（详情+评论，占采集额度）再分析（约 6-25 分钟）→云端生成报告：账号定位（IP 主线：定位/受众分层/变现模式）、内容支柱（3-5 根+各自 A3 率）、人群画像、打法拆解、获客建议。计费：非会员首次限免、之后按积分计（job 创建即扣）；需登录——LOGIN_REQUIRED/积分不足 QUOTA_EXCEEDED 提前返回。启动后立即返回 pending 回执（不阻塞对话），完成后对用户说「栗子报告」拿报告摘要+直达链接。调用纪律：先 query_local_data(source=\"reports\", keyword=账号名) 查已有账号研究报告（type=account）——有就免费解读，不要重复生成。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"platform":{"description":"平台（默认按链接自动识别）","enum":["xiaohongshu","douyin"],"type":"string"},"url":{"description":"博主主页链接（小红书 /user/profile/ 或抖音 /user/）","type":"string"}},"required":["url"],"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_account_deep_research"}

tools.name: leadsradar_add_monitor
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"把一个对标账号加入对标库并开启监控（与插件「纳入监控」同源）。参数 url=博主主页链接（账号须先用 leadsradar_capture_profile 采集过，未采集会返回 ACCOUNT_NOT_COLLECTED 及指引）。monitor 含义：用户说「监控/盯着」时传 true（加对标且开监控，需登录；云端 24h 盯盘为会员权益，未激活时在插件监控页点亮该账号胶囊可激活）；只说「加对标」传 false（免登录幂等）。提示：监控命中与报告在插件监控页 / web 工作台查看。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"monitor":{"description":"true=加对标且开监控（需登录）；false/不传=只确认对标库成员（免登录）。用户提到「监控」即 true","type":"boolean"},"url":{"description":"博主主页链接（capture_profile 用过的同一条）","type":"string"}},"required":["url"],"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_add_monitor"}

tools.name: leadsradar_capture_note_comments
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"采集一篇笔记/视频的评论区（评论内容、点赞数、评论者信息）。适合：找客户线索（评论留资/求推荐/问价格）、挖用户需求与痛点。需提供笔记 URL。安全限额：单篇最多 500 条评论（为保障账号安全，超限请求会被自动拒绝并返回可读错误——请在布置大批量任务前先告知用户此限制）。⭐触达/回评等出分级名单的场景（⭐R96ez）：默认 limit=30 只覆盖热门区——采集后须再调 query_local_data(source=comments, note_url=同链接) 拉本地库已有评论，按「作者+评论内容」去重合并，分级与名单永远基于合并后全量，禁只用本轮新采（重跑不合并会导致名单与低档计数集体缩水）。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"limit":{"description":"评论条数上限（默认 30 只覆盖热门区；触达/分级名单场景建议显式传 100+）","type":"integer"},"url":{"description":"笔记/视频 URL","type":"string"}},"required":["url"],"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_capture_note_comments"}

tools.name: leadsradar_capture_profile
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"采集某位博主主页的全部/近期作品列表（小红书或抖音）。适合：对标账号分析、账号内容策略研究。需提供博主主页 URL。安全限额：单批最多 300 条、30 分钟内累计最多 600 条（为保障账号安全，超限请求会被自动拒绝并返回可读错误——请在布置大批量任务前先告知用户此限制，并主动建议拆批）。⭐深度采集版（deep:true）：与插件账号 Tab「深度采集」按钮同源同引擎——逐条进详情页采集正文+全部评论，收尾自动做评论意向快扫（A3 分级）与账号四分类打分；因需逐条翻页耗时 5-20 分钟，会立即返回 pending 回执（不阻塞对话），完成后对栗子说「栗子报告」取报告。深度采集同样必须前台浏览器窗口。非会员深采逐条占采集限额。⭐R96cf 快扫版默认联动插件监控页「扫描规则」的深度快扫设置（默认开、可在监控页关）：开着时列表采完自动对最新 4 条作品采评论（只采评论不做正文拆解，已扫过自动跳过、每轮只深扫新作品），回执深扫行如实转述即可、无需额外操作。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"comments_limit":{"description":"deep 模式每篇评论上限（10-100，默认 50）","type":"integer"},"deep":{"description":"深度采集开关：true=逐条进详情+采评论+A3 快扫+四分类（与插件「深度采集」按钮同链，5-20 分钟异步 pending→栗子报告）；默认 false 仅作品列表","type":"boolean"},"limit":{"description":"采集条数上限（1-300，默认 20；deep 模式下为详情条数 1-50，默认 20）","type":"integer"},"url":{"description":"博主主页 URL（如 https://www.xiaohongshu.com/user/profile/xxx）","type":"string"}},"required":["url"],"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_capture_profile"}

tools.name: leadsradar_claim_pending_result
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"领取探栗插件侧已完成但未被认领的任务结果（不占采集限额、秒回）。何时用：①任务超时后（插件可能已跑完，先领再决定是否重发，避免双耗采集额度）；②宿主/会话重启后回来；③connection_status 的 extension.pendingResults 列表非空时。领取结果里 results 为结果本体可直接使用，pending 为剩余未领取摘要。领不到再用 query_local_data 查本地库，都没有才考虑重发任务。⭐R96bw 用户喊「栗子报告」时的合一入口：先调本工具领 pending 结果（有刚完成的报告先交付最新一份）；无 pending/领完再 query_local_data(source=\"reports\") 列最近报告一览（≤7 条）收尾。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"taskId":{"description":"可选：要领取的 taskId（来自 connection_status 的 extension.pendingResults）；不传=领取全部未领取结果","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_claim_pending_result"}

tools.name: leadsradar_comment_reply
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"AI 回评话术（成交栗回评段，⭐R96dr 开窗）：为指定评论生成 3 条可直接发的评论区回复候选。与插件评论弹窗「AI 回复」同源同引擎（云端 AI 生成，贴评论原文+意向档位写语气，aiReply 会员日限同池）。已登录用；未登录返回 LOGIN_REQUIRED 引导「栗子登录」，日限用完(429)按回评包格式自写话术降级交付（标注「自写版·未走探栗意向引擎」）。确认制流程：先生成给用户选，用户确认发出后用 leadsradar_mark_lead 标已回落档。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"comment_text":{"description":"评论原文（必填——回评要贴着对方评论写）","type":"string"},"commenter_name":{"description":"评论者昵称（选填）","type":"string"},"intent_level":{"description":"意向档位（A3 系=客户语气/A2=潜在/默认 A1 噪音档兜底语气）","enum":["A3_strong","A3_weak","A2","A1"],"type":"string"},"note_title":{"description":"笔记标题（AI 上下文，选填）","type":"string"}},"required":["comment_text"],"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_comment_reply"}

tools.name: leadsradar_connection_status
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"检查探栗（LeadsRadar）浏览器插件连接状态与接入进度。开始任何采集前、以及配对等待期间应轮询本工具（每 8 秒一次，最多 12 次）：onboarding.step=1 表示插件未连接（需用户开启插件设置页「智能体连接」开关）；step=2 表示等待用户在插件中批准配对；step=3（extension.connected=true）表示已就绪，可以调用采集工具。extension.account.loggedIn 为登录态（true=已登录/false=未登录/null=未知）：存选题（save_topic）等云端写入动作动手前必查——false 时先引导用户在插件个人中心登录，别先消耗采集额度；loggedIn=true 时顺带可用 extension.account.nickname 称呼用户。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{},"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_connection_status"}

tools.name: leadsradar_dm_reply
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"AI 私信话术（成交栗触达包私信段）：为指定评论生成 3 条可直接发的私信候选（first 首触/followup 追问）。与插件评论弹窗「AI 私信」同源同引擎（云端 AI 生成+lf_leads 自动建档+aiReply 会员日限）。已登录用；未登录返回 LOGIN_REQUIRED 引导「栗子登录」，用户不想登录时按触达包格式自写话术降级交付。评论者主页 URL 在采集回执 author_url 字段（触达包每条带上）。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"comment_text":{"description":"评论原文（必填——私信要贴着对方评论写）","type":"string"},"commenter_name":{"description":"评论者昵称（建档用，选填）","type":"string"},"intent_level":{"description":"意向档位（默认 A3）","enum":["A3_strong","A3_weak","A2"],"type":"string"},"lead_id":{"description":"已有线索 ID（⭐233 fallback 自动建档时二触以上传，免重复建）","type":"string"},"note_title":{"description":"笔记标题（建档用，选填）","type":"string"},"platform":{"description":"平台（默认 xiaohongshu）","enum":["xiaohongshu","douyin"],"type":"string"},"stage":{"description":"first=首触（默认）/followup=追问（对方未回复时换角度再触达）","enum":["first","followup"],"type":"string"}},"required":["comment_text"],"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_dm_reply"}

tools.name: leadsradar_download_media
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"下载一篇笔记/视频的无水印素材到用户的浏览器下载目录（与插件「下载素材」按钮同源同链，完全免费、不占会员权益、与「提取文案」无关）。视频=MP4+封面图，图文=图集图片，统一落在浏览器下载目录的独立子文件夹。适合：用户要拿原素材做二次创作/剪辑。参数 note 传采集工具返回的笔记对象（或直接给 url）。注意：下载会后台访问一次作品页刷新地址，占用一次采集限额；链接签名有时效，请勿缓存结果批量重试。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"note":{"description":"采集结果中的笔记对象（原样传回，优先用它的 note_url/platform/封面）","type":"object"},"url":{"description":"笔记/视频 URL（未传 note 时必填）","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_download_media"}

tools.name: leadsradar_extract_text
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"提取一篇笔记/视频的文案（与插件「提取文案」按钮同源同链）：视频=云端语音转文字逐字稿（ASR），图文=图片 OCR。适合：抠口播文案、文案拆解、仿写改写。参数传 note 对象（按 work_type 自动分流视频/图文）或直接给 url（默认按视频处理）。需登录、占「文案提取」额度（体验版 1 次/天、付费按月——与采集限额独立两本账）；云端转录约 15~60 秒有进度提示。未登录返回 LOGIN_REQUIRED 并附登录指引（原话转述给用户）。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"note":{"description":"采集结果中的笔记对象（原样传回，用它的 work_type/note_url/标题）","type":"object"},"url":{"description":"笔记/视频 URL（未传 note 时必填）","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_extract_text"}

tools.name: leadsradar_get_daily_report
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"取获客日报（每天自动生成的昨日获客简讯，需已登录）：五段全量返回——hotHits 爆文命中 / a3Strong A3 强意向客户 / system 系统报告 / radarRank 雷达榜 / report 新报告，每段带条目数组，宿主可直接完整渲染给用户（此数据不涉密）。近 7 天没有日报时返回空并说明原因（需要监控账号当天有数据）。未登录时引导先「栗子登录」。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{},"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_get_daily_report"}

tools.name: leadsradar_get_latest_skills
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"获取探栗五技能（情报栗 radar / 洞察栗 insights / 创作栗 creator / 成交栗 closer / 管家栗 helper）云端最新版 SKILL.md。何时用：connection_status 的 skills_latest 对照宿主技能文件 frontmatter version 发现落后时——技能文件装在宿主技能库里（探栗MCP 够不着），本工具把最新 SKILL.md 全文递上来，宿主 AI 展示给用户整体复制、按宿主自己的技能安装方式覆盖旧文件即可完成技能升级。不传 name 返回五技能的云端最新版本表与更新指引；传 name 返回该技能 SKILL.md 全文（content 字段）与从 frontmatter 提取的 version。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"name":{"description":"技能名（五栗之一）；不传=返回版本表+更新指引","enum":["radar","insights","creator","closer","helper"],"type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_get_latest_skills"}

tools.name: leadsradar_lead_records
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"查线索账本（⭐R96dr 开窗，拍板②）：云端 lf_leads 线索记录——待处理/已回/已留资/已流失四档统计+明细（评论者/评论内容/意向档/作品/主页链接），按时间倒序（最近操作在前）。同一探栗账号全终端聚合：插件收件箱标的、栗子标记的都在（换宿主/换电脑记录都在）。适合「谁还没回」「触达记录」「未完成任务」类查询。需已登录（未登录返回 LOGIN_REQUIRED 引导「栗子登录」）。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"limit":{"description":"返回条数上限（1-200，默认 50）","type":"integer"},"status":{"description":"筛选：new=待处理（未完成）/contacted=已回/converted=已留资/lost=已流失；不传=全部","enum":["new","contacted","converted","lost"],"type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_lead_records"}

tools.name: leadsradar_mark_lead
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"触达结果标记（⭐R96dr 开窗，拍板③）：把一条线索的跟进状态写回云端 lf_leads 账本（web 线索农场与插件收件箱同源，跨宿主可查）。action=mark_replied 标已回（可带 text 留痕发出的话术；无 lead_id 时带 comment_text 等上下文自动建档）/ mark_converted 已留资 / mark_lost 已流失 / reopen 重开待处理（后三者需 lead_id，先用 leadsradar_lead_records 查）。回评或私信「实际发出后」调用——这是触达闭环的记账动作。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"action":{"description":"mark_replied=标已回（默认）/mark_converted=已留资/mark_lost=已流失/reopen=重开待处理","enum":["mark_replied","mark_converted","mark_lost","reopen"],"type":"string"},"comment_text":{"description":"无 lead_id 自动建档时必填：评论原文","type":"string"},"commenter_name":{"description":"自动建档用：评论者昵称（选填）","type":"string"},"intent_level":{"description":"自动建档用：意向档位（选填）","enum":["A3_strong","A3_weak","A2"],"type":"string"},"lead_id":{"description":"线索 ID（mark_replied 可缺省走自动建档；其余动作必填）","type":"string"},"note_title":{"description":"自动建档用：笔记标题（选填）","type":"string"},"platform":{"description":"自动建档用：平台（默认 xiaohongshu）","enum":["xiaohongshu","douyin"],"type":"string"},"text":{"description":"mark_replied 留痕：实际发出的回评/私信话术（选填）","type":"string"}},"required":["action"],"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_mark_lead"}

tools.name: leadsradar_note_deep_research
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"深度拆解一篇作品（与插件「深度拆解」按钮同源同引擎，单篇深度拆解有且只有这一种）：自动补齐作品详情/文案/评论后跑云端 AI 深度分析（L2 级），产出线索漏斗（🟢A3强/🟠A3弱/🟡A2/⚪A1 四级分级）、线索指数评分、最该做的事。计费：本地已有该作品的拆解报告时直接免费解读（不扣券）；没有才发起云端分析（扣 1 张拆解券，约 1~3 分钟），force=true 强制重拆（会再扣券）。需登录——未登录返回 LOGIN_REQUIRED，请把错误中的登录指引原话转述给用户。返回 pending=true 表示云端仍在分析（券已扣、不会重复计费）——请引导用户稍等一两分钟后说「栗子报告」即可拿到完整报告。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"force":{"description":"true=跳过本地已有报告强制重新拆解（再扣 1 张券）；默认 false 已有报告先免费解读","type":"boolean"},"note":{"description":"采集结果中的笔记对象（原样传回，用它的 note_url/标题）","type":"object"},"url":{"description":"笔记/视频 URL（未传 note 时必填）","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_note_deep_research"}

tools.name: leadsradar_note_detail
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"采集一篇笔记/视频的详情数据（正文、标签、互动数据、作者信息等）。适合：爆款拆解、单篇深度分析。需提供笔记 URL。安全限额：单批最多 20 篇、30 分钟内累计最多 100 篇（为保障账号安全，超限请求会被自动拒绝并返回可读错误——请在布置大批量任务前先告知用户此限制，并主动建议拆批）。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"url":{"description":"笔记/视频 URL","type":"string"}},"required":["url"],"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_note_detail"}

tools.name: leadsradar_pair_login
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"「栗子登录」：帮用户完成插件与账号的登录连接——自动打开网页登录页（app.leadsradar.cn，扫码或账密登录），登录成功后自动连接插件（JWT 自动回流，无需手抄配对码），返回登录身份（会员档位/邮箱/积分）。已登录时幂等返回当前身份。注意：这是一个最长等 5 分钟的长任务（等用户在网页上慢慢登录），期间会有进度提示；用户没登录完就超时的话，把返回里的链接给用户——之后任意时间登录都会自动连接。付款/开通会员不走本工具：直接给用户会员页链接 app.leadsradar.cn/membership（已登录态点开支付）。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{},"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_pair_login"}

tools.name: leadsradar_pause_monitor
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"「栗子关监控/取消监控」：关掉一个账号的云端监控（status→paused，与插件监控页开关「监控深→未监控」同源）。只停监控不删对标——账号保留在对标库，本机扫描不受影响；含「我的账号」（is_self 自带监控也能关）。需已登录（未登录返回 LOGIN_REQUIRED，引导用户对栗子说「栗子登录」）。参数 url 或 name 至少其一（重名带 platform 消歧）。回执 message 照抄；返回 TARGET_NOT_FOUND 说明该账号本来就没开监控（如实告知用户，不要重试）。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"name":{"description":"账号名（无链接时用；重名时须带 platform 消歧）","type":"string"},"platform":{"description":"平台（xiaohongshu/douyin，重名账号消歧用）","type":"string"},"url":{"description":"博主主页链接（优先，精确匹配）","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_pause_monitor"}

tools.name: leadsradar_query_local_data
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"查询探栗插件本地数据库（只读，不访问网络、不占采集限额）。适合：查看/统计历史采集的作品、账号、已存选题、某篇笔记的评论，以及本地缓存的 AI 研究报告（作品拆解/账号研究/赛道研究/账号复盘），生成数据概览或巡逻报告。返回按时间倒序的记录列表（条数上限 200）。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"keyword":{"description":"可选：模糊匹配标题/作者名/昵称","type":"string"},"limit":{"description":"返回条数上限（1-200，默认 50）","type":"integer"},"note_url":{"description":"source=comments 时必填：目标笔记 URL","type":"string"},"platform":{"description":"可选：按平台过滤","enum":["xiaohongshu","douyin"],"type":"string"},"source":{"description":"数据源：works=已存选题记录，notes=全部采集过的作品，accounts=采集过的账号，comments=某篇笔记的评论（须配 note_url），reports=本地缓存的 AI 研究报告（返回类型/标题/一句话建议/报告直达链接，全文在 web 端打开；⭐R96bw 不传 keyword=全部报告按时间倒序——「栗子报告」列表口径，配 limit=7 出最近一览）","enum":["works","notes","accounts","comments","reports"],"type":"string"}},"required":["source"],"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_query_local_data"}

tools.name: leadsradar_remove_benchmark
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"「栗子删对标」：从对标库删除一个对标账号腾出对标位（与插件监控页卡片删除同源，三处同删：本地对标库+云端目标表+本机监控连带停止）。⚠️ 破坏性操作必须先确认：调用前把要删的账号报给用户确认一句（账号名+平台+粉丝数+是否监控中），用户确认后才调——用户指令里已点名且语义明确也不跳过确认；批量删除逐个确认逐个删。回执 message 照抄（含对标位 N/M 与云端删除说明）；返回 ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND 时先 leadsradar_query_local_data(source=\"accounts\") 查对标库核对准确账号名再重试。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"name":{"description":"账号名（无链接时用；重名时须带 platform 消歧）","type":"string"},"platform":{"description":"平台（xiaohongshu/douyin，重名账号消歧用）","type":"string"},"url":{"description":"博主主页链接（优先，精确匹配）","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_remove_benchmark"}

tools.name: leadsradar_save_topic
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"把一篇采集到的笔记存入用户的选题仓库（云端入库待分拣，web 选题仓库与插件工作台均可见，与插件「存选题」同源）。适合：你筛选出值得创作跟进的爆款/线索笔记时落库存档。参数 note 直接传采集工具（search_notes / capture_profile / note_detail）返回的笔记对象，原样传回即可。注意：此操作需要用户已登录——未登录时会返回 LOGIN_REQUIRED 错误，请把错误中的登录指引原样转述给用户，登录后重试即可。只写一次库、不占采集限额。回执带 topic_total（云端选题仓库当前总条数，服务端真源）与 topic_url（选题卡直达链接）——核对仓库总量直读 topic_total，勿用本地 works 反查充当仓库计数。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"note":{"description":"采集结果中的笔记对象（原样传回，须含 title 字段）","type":"object"},"remark":{"description":"可选：存入原因备注（如「评论留资多，适合跟拍」）","type":"string"}},"required":["note"],"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_save_topic"}

tools.name: leadsradar_scan_settings
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"「栗子扫描设置/栗子监控设置」：查看或修改扫描/监控设置（与插件监控页「扫描/监控设置」同份设置，对标账号/我的账号的本机扫描与栗子扫对标现扫深扫同份生效；已登录时回执附带命中条件/观察期/云端监控频率/起扫时间回显，频率/时间只读指路 web 端雷达页）。不传任何参数=查看当前设置；传哪个参数改哪项（其余保持现值）：first 首次扫描条数 20-500（首次扫描一次干满建池）、rescan 新增扫描条数 5-20（新增扫描只追新绝不重扫已扫作品）、deepComments 评论采集开关（默认开）、deepCommentLimit 每条作品评论采集上限 10-100、hitMode 命中条件模式 dynamic=均赞×N（点赞≥该账号近期均赞×N）/follower=粉丝×N（点赞≥粉丝数×N）/fixed=固定赞（点赞≥固定值 N）、hitValue 命中条件阈值（均赞×/粉丝× 0.1-10，固定赞 ≥1 整数，不传沿用当前值）、observeHours 新作品观察期 1-168 小时（云端监控观察窗：新作品窗内跟踪判命中、超窗未命中转观察完成——仅云端监控生效，本机扫描不吃）。命中条件+观察期=命中判定规则，与插件监控页「命中观察规则」同源（命中条件对两端生效：本机扫描上报+云端自动扫描同一池；观察期仅云端监控生效——⭐R96dw 代码实查语义校正），修改需已登录（未登录回 LOGIN_REQUIRED）。越界值自动夹到边界；回执 message 照抄（含改前→改后对照）。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"deepCommentLimit":{"description":"每条作品评论采集上限（10-100，默认 30）","type":"number"},"deepComments":{"description":"评论采集开关（默认开）","type":"boolean"},"first":{"description":"首次扫描条数（20-500，默认 50；首次扫描一次干满建池）","type":"number"},"hitMode":{"description":"命中条件模式（dynamic=均赞×N：点赞≥该账号近期均赞×N / follower=粉丝×N：点赞≥粉丝数×N / fixed=固定赞：点赞≥固定值 N；与插件监控页「命中观察规则」同源，对两端生效，需登录）","enum":["dynamic","follower","fixed"],"type":"string"},"hitValue":{"description":"命中条件阈值（均赞×/粉丝×：0.1-10；固定赞：≥1 整数；不传沿用当前值）","type":"number"},"observeHours":{"description":"新作品观察期（1-168 小时，默认 72；云端监控观察窗：窗内跟踪判命中、超窗未命中转观察完成——仅云端监控生效，本机扫描不吃）","type":"number"},"rescan":{"description":"新增扫描条数（5-20，默认 10；新增扫描只追新）","type":"number"}},"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_scan_settings"}

tools.name: leadsradar_search_notes
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"在小红书或抖音按关键词搜索作品并采集列表数据（标题、点赞、收藏、评论数、作者、链接）。适合：赛道调研、爆款发现、选题灵感。返回按热度排序的笔记列表。安全限额：单批最多 300 条、30 分钟内累计最多 600 条（为保障账号安全，超限请求会被自动拒绝并返回可读错误——请在布置大批量任务前先告知用户此限制，并主动建议拆批）。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"keyword":{"description":"搜索关键词，例如「家装获客」","type":"string"},"limit":{"description":"采集条数上限（1-300，默认 10）","type":"integer"},"platform":{"description":"平台，默认 xiaohongshu","enum":["xiaohongshu","douyin"],"type":"string"}},"required":["keyword"],"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_search_notes"}

tools.name: leadsradar_track_deep_research
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"赛道深度研究（与插件赛道页「赛道深度研究」按钮同源同引擎，赛道级深度研究有且只有这一种）：自动搜索关键词→采 80 条作品列表 + Top20 深采（逐条详情+评论）→云端 AI 生成三段式报告（赛道诊断：值不值得做/市场阶段/变现潜力/进入难度；需求洞察：内容缺口；策略对标：六策略+对标账号）。计费：非会员首次限免 1 次，之后 8 积分/次；需登录——LOGIN_REQUIRED/积分不足 QUOTA_EXCEEDED 会提前返回不白等。无缓存时全程 15-30 分钟：启动采集后立即返回 pending 回执（不阻塞对话），完成后对用户说「栗子报告」拿报告摘要+直达链接；1 天内同关键词自动复用采集缓存（跳过采集直接 AI，约 2-6 分钟）。⭐扫描量可调（R96bv）：默认采 80 条列表+Top20 深采，用户主动指定扫描量/深采量/评论量时才透传 sample_count（20-120）/top_deep（5-30）/comment_limit（10-100），超范围引擎自动夹回边界——回执 message 带实际生效参数，pending 转达照抄即可。调用纪律：先 query_local_data(source=\"reports\", keyword=关键词) 查已有赛道报告——有就免费解读，不要重复生成；force=true 忽略缓存强制重采（会再扣积分）。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"comment_limit":{"description":"每篇评论上限（10-100，默认 20）——用户指定评论采多少时透传，默认不传","type":"integer"},"force":{"description":"true=忽略 1 天内采集缓存强制重采；默认 false 缓存命中直接 AI","type":"boolean"},"keyword":{"description":"赛道关键词（如「辅食」「亲子露营」）","type":"string"},"platform":{"description":"平台（默认 xiaohongshu 小红书）","enum":["xiaohongshu","douyin"],"type":"string"},"sample_count":{"description":"列表采样条数（20-120，默认 80）——用户主动要求多扫/少扫时透传，默认不传","type":"integer"},"top_deep":{"description":"深采条数（5-30，默认 20）——用户指定深采几条时透传，默认不传","type":"integer"}},"required":["keyword"],"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_track_deep_research"}

tools.name: leadsradar_whoami
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"现核当前浏览器登录的小红书/抖音账号（closer 回复任务表「回复主体」行数据源，⭐R96ew 新增、⭐R96ex 升级两分支引导、⭐R96ey 加 open_url 代开）。只读已打开的平台页面数据（零采集：不滚动、不占采集限额）。返回当前登录的平台+昵称；查不到分两种引导（⭐R96ex）：没开平台页→传了 open_url 则插件自动代开该页面再读（未传才引导用户手动开）；开了未登录→message 引导「先在该页面完成登录（右上角能看到自己头像=已登录），登录后再复查」；部分平台核到时 message 附「另：X 页面已开但未检测到登录」。closer 出回评/私信稿前必调（传 open_url=作品链接），核到填「⭐已核 @真昵称」、核不到本步阻断按 message 引导用户、复查核到才出稿（closer 1.4.12 前置阻断闭环）。","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"open_url":{"description":"可选——没开任何平台页时让插件自动打开的页面 URL（一般传作品链接，仅接受小红书/抖音域名 https 链接）；传了它「没开页」分支不再让用户手动开页，插件代开后直接读登录态","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"leadsradar_whoami"}

depth/lineage、delegation_allowed=trueを注入し、必要な追加委譲は許可する。dispatch した子は投げっぱなしでよい＝親はここで待たない。Codex親とClaude Code親にはAitermが回答本文を自動配送する。parent_deliveryがある場合はwait起動も通常の回答回収も不要。親は作業を続けるかターンを終える。Cursor親にはparent_deliveryとwait_processが付く。作業を続ければ次のツール返りに回答が差し込まれ、ターンを終える前にwait_processを背景で起動するとidle中の完了でも起きられる。ポーリングとpty_read(agent_transcript:true)は不要。その他の親では、完了通知をreceiptの tools.name: autopilot

tools.name: brain_predict
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"READ-ONLY — no side effects, no writes, no external network calls. Requires a valid instance_id (your Redis brain). No rate limits. Call at session start when working on a specific feature or debugging area. tools.name: cachly_tool
tools.canonical_json:
{"description":"Run any of cachly's specialist tools by name.

The most-used tools are listed separately above. This one reaches the

{"_meta":{"securitySchemes":[{"scopes":["openid","profile","email"],"type":"oauth2"}]},"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"openWorldHint":false,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Check what Bowmark can do for this task"},"description":"**Use this whenever a task touches a live website.** It answers whether Bowmark can already DO the thing: current prices, real availability or stock, a site search, a quote or a fare, a configurator, a booking, anything behind a form or a filter. **Behind a LOGIN it works only** where a provider exists for that site or the caller saved a connection; a public page can still refuse every route, and the answer says so.

**Use this for Bowmark questions too.** Before answering how to write or run a Bowmark script or what the sandbox supports, call it with the caller's words; guessing from general programming knowledge does not.

**Checking is cheap, so check.** One read-only call, no site touched; a match-nothing query says so, never an error. If nothing fits, you lost one cheap call; use your normal approach.

Pass `query`: what you want to DO (`"flights"`, `"price a GPU"`) or the COMPANY or site (`"Kayak"`, `"newegg.com"`). Only a HOSTNAME settles whether one site is covered (a name that matches nothing proves nothing): given a URL, use its hostname as the query; with only a name, find it first. Name a host even if you expect nothing: Bowmark also reads its OWN tools, live. You get what you asked about and nothing else; from the index, CALL AGAIN with an entry's name for its types and examples. Several parts? `plunk_add_workflow_steps`.

**Step types** (pass only that type's arguments):
- `SEND_EMAIL` — `templateId`; optional `recipientEmail` for a fixed address.
- `DELAY` — `amount` + `unit` (at most 365 days).
- `WAIT_FOR_EVENT` — `eventName`; optional timeout via `amount` + `unit`. The flow continues
  on the same path whether the event arrives or the timeout passes.
- `CONDITION` — `field` + `operator` (+ `value`) for yes/no, or `field` + `branches` for
  several outcomes. Connect what follows with `after` = the condition and `branch`.
- `UPDATE_CONTACT` — `updates` (data fields to set) and/or `subscriptionAction`.
- `WEBHOOK` — `url`, optional `method`, `headers`, `body`.
- `EXIT` — ends the run, optional `reason`. Nothing can follow it.

**Placement:** by default the step goes after the only open end of the workflow. Pass `after`
(a step ID) to place it elsewhere, plus `branch` when `after` is a CONDITION. If that position
already leads somewhere, the step is inserted in between. An unconnected condition branch ends
the run for contacts that take it.

**Returns:** The created step including its ID.

{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false,"readOnlyHint":true},"description":"Returns the current time.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"format":{"default":"2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00","description":"The output time format, which can be a predefined format or a custom layout.

## Predefined Formats

`Unixdate`, `RFC1123`, `RFC1123z`, `RFC3339`, `DateOnly`, `RFC822z`, `RFC3339nano`, `Kitchen`, `StampMilli`, `StampNano`, `RFC822`, `StampMicro`, `TimeOnly`, `ANSIC`, `Rubydate`, `RFC850`, `Stamp`, `DateTime`

## Custom Format

A custom format can be built using the following components. Each component shows an example of how a part of the reference time is formatted. Only these values are recognized. Any text in the layout string that is not a recognized component will be treated as a literal.

- Year: "2006", "06"
- Month: "Jan", "January", "01", "1"
- Day of the week: "Mon", "Monday"
- Day of the month: "2", "_2", "02"
- Day of the year: "__2", "002"
- Hour: "15", "3", "03" (PM or AM)
- Minute: "4", "04"
- Second: "5", "05"
- AM/PM mark: "PM"

### Numeric Time Zone Offsets

- "-0700"     (±hhmm)
- "-07:00"    (±hh:mm)
- "-07"       (±hh)
- "-070000"   (±hhmmss)
- "-07:00:00" (±hh:mm:ss)

Replacing the sign with a "Z" triggers ISO 8601 behavior, which prints "Z" for the UTC zone:

- "Z0700"      (Z or ±hhmm)
- "Z07:00"     (Z or ±hh:mm)
- "Z07"        (Z or ±hh)
- "Z070000"    (Z or ±hhmmss)
- "Z07:00:00"  (Z or ±hh:mm:ss)

Within the format string, the underscores in "_2" and "__2" represent spaces that may be replaced by digits if the following number has multiple digits, for compatibility with fixed-width Unix time formats. A leading zero represents a zero-padded value.
The formats __2 and 002 are space-padded and zero-padded three-character day of year; there is no unpadded day of year format.

### Fractional Seconds

A comma or decimal point followed by one or more zeros represents a fractional second, printed to the given number of decimal places. A comma or decimal point followed by one or more nines represents a fractional second with trailing zeros removed.
For example, "15:04:05.000" formats or parses with millisecond precision.","type":"string"},"timezone":{"default":"UTC","description":"The target timezone for the output, in IANA format (e.g., 'America/New_York').","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"name":"current_time"}

tools.name: get_fundamentals_history
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"The stored figures for one ticker, each row carrying its period (fy, fp: for a quarterly row the CALENDAR quarter containing the period end) and its filing date as each market records it (for Taiwan, the general statutory reporting deadline — a proxy, usually on or after the actual release). Filter with metric (comma-separated) and from (period-end lower bound); as_of keeps only filings dated on or before that day. On a free key, a company outside the full-history sample answers with its most recent reported fiscal year only: full_history false and history_depth say so, and older filings exist. Long histories are capped at 250 rows, keeping the most recent rows of EVERY metric (per_metric says how many of each); narrow with metric/from for the rest. Suffixes are not all listed equities, and not all figures mean what the column name suggests. .TW income-statement values are SINGLE-QUARTER (three-month) amounts: Taiwan files cumulative year-to-date totals and they are converted before you see them, so do NOT difference adjacent quarters again. A .TW row with fp FY is the full-year total, not a quarter. .TW current quarters come from the TWSE OpenAPI (Open Government Data License v1.0, attribution required); history from 2013 comes from the TWSE MOPS XBRL archive, which is NOT open data: keep both attribution notices and do not call Taiwan figures open data. US figures (SEC EDGAR) are public information. .TW filing dates are the statutory reporting deadline, a proxy, not the actual release date; for some financial and foreign first-listed companies and for weekend deadlines it can be earlier than the real deadline (known issue, being corrected). .BE is Belgian STATUTORY SOLO accounts, never group consolidation. .NZC is New Zealand REGISTERED CHARITIES (Charities Register annual returns), not listed companies; their `filed` is the register's record date, and about a quarter of those are one day early (known issue, being corrected). .FR is INPI's register of keyed-in annual accounts: `filed` is dateDepot, the register's own deposit date, and balance sheets are included. Coverage is substantially complete from 2022; 2017-2021 is still backfilling. Turnover is lawfully absent from roughly 36% of French deposits (confidentiality declarations); it is PRESENT on 64.0% of company-periods, and the API's /api/v1/fundamentals/quality endpoint reports the measured share of every metric in every market. The reporting model rides in `form` (K consolidated, C complet, S simplifie); consolidated and own accounts are separate deposits with their own dates, so both can appear for one SIREN and period. .DK `filed` is the Copenhagen calendar date of the register's publication, a date only before 11 April 2015; Danish history starts in June 2012. .DK figures are the reporting entity's own accounts: for a Danish-GAAP parent that also publishes group accounts, usually its own figures, not the group's; for an IFRS filer (form annual/ifrs), the consolidated group's. .DK turnover is present on only 10.6% of company-periods (Belgium is lower still at 8.1%) because Danish reporting class B may publish gross profit instead — that absence is lawful disclosure, not missing data, and gross profit is never a substitute for it. A .DK `form` is annual (Danish GAAP) or annual/ifrs, with the period's length appended when a year is not 11-13 months (annual/15m for a long first year); /liquidation marks accounts drawn up in liquidation and /correction a period the register holds only as a corrected report; /same-as-adjacent, always last, marks both of two adjacent annual periods whose figures are identical (the filer may have repeated another year's figures; they are served as filed, and the flag does not say which period, if either, is wrong); interim reports are excluded. .EE is the Estonian e-Business Register (companies, associations and foundations that file an annual report; CC BY 4.0): `filed` is the date the register records the report as submitted, an Estonian calendar date; figures are the company's own (basis solo) and, where the register's key-figure file has them, a consolidated report's group figures ride beside them with basis consolidated (form …/consolidated); about 1,900 reports, many of them consolidated and among them those of banks and listed groups, are not included, because the register, not the filer, enters their key figures manually after the report is submitted, so the submission date does not date those figures, and some companies have no figures here at all (known issue); form annual/pdf marks a turnover, assets or employee-count figure taken only from the separate boxes the filer keys in (the register's PDF key figures), not from the report's statements; a report filed only as a PDF carries just those figures; employees is in full-time equivalents (unit FTE). .SE is Bolagsverket's digitally submitted annual reports from 2020: `filed` is the Sunday ending the week (Monday to Sunday) in which the bulk file places the report, a proxy for its registration date: expected not to be earlier than registration and up to six days later, not yet compared report by report with the registration date (known issue); liabilities exclude untaxed reserves (untaxed_reserves). For .EE and .SE the response's `attributes` gives the industry code with its source and date, and for .EE the shareholders that are legal persons; natural persons and sole proprietors are never included, so that list is never the full ownership. With as_of, an attribute known only as of a later date is left out and named in attributes.withheld_after_as_of. .SK is the Slovak Register účtovných závierok (RÚZ, CC0): structured statements of companies and other legal persons from financial year 2019; `filed` is the later of the statement's filing date and the last day the register changed the report holding the figures, so never before the filing date and usually a day or so after it; micro entities (form annual/micro) report revenue as sales of goods plus own products and services; IFRS statements filed only as PDF, among them many of the largest companies, are not included, nor are banks', insurers', funds' and public bodies' statements or single-entry statements. .LV is the Latvian Register of Enterprises' annual-report data (CC0), financial periods ending 2020 or later: the files state no filing date, so `filed` is the Riga calendar date the register's data record of the report was created, a proxy read as UTC (the register's own files indicate Riga local time, so it can be one day later than the record's creation, never earlier), which can be later than the filing, by an amount the files do not show, and as far as we know never earlier; the files do not show changes, so a report changed before we first collected it is held in its changed version; associations and foundations are not included. Natural persons who are entrepreneurs are never included for either. Period labels: fp is FY for an annual row; for a quarterly row (US, Taiwan) fy and fp are the CALENDAR year and quarter that contain the period end, not the company's own fiscal quarter: Apple's quarter ending 2025-12-27 is 2025 Q4, which Apple calls Q1 of fiscal 2026, so name a quarter by its period end, not by the label. A latest-view fact with a quarterly fp is ONE quarter's figure, not a full year. Licence: when you relay figures, keep the `attribution` notices and the `licence` notice of the response with them.","inputSchema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"as_of":{"description":"Filing-date cut-off, YYYY-MM-DD: only filings dated on or before that day","pattern":"^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$","type":"string"},"from":{"description":"Earliest period end to include, YYYY-MM-DD","pattern":"^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$","type":"string"},"metric":{"description":"Comma-separated metrics, e.g. revenue,net_income","type":"string"},"ticker":{"description":"Ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL or 2330.TW","type":"string"}},"required":["ticker"],"type":"object"},"name":"get_fundamentals_history","title":"Reported history for a company"}

tools.name: search_companies
tools.canonical_json: {"description":"Look up the ticker for a company name or partial symbol — 'Apple', 'TSMC', '2330', 'samsung', 'LVMH'. Use this first when the user names a company rather than a ticker, and check the market of the hit: a local subsidiary or a namesake in another country can share the name. Pass market (US, JP, TW, KR, FR, BE, DK, NZC) to search one market only.
